name: minisociali-qa-automation
description: Playwright + Cucumber automation suite for the MiniSociali sample app.

scripts.test: start-server-and-test "npm --prefix sample-app start" http://127.0.0.1:4000 "npm run test:cucumber -- --tags \"not @known-bug\""
scripts.test:api: start-server-and-test "npm --prefix sample-app start" http://127.0.0.1:4000 "npm run test:cucumber -- --tags \"@api and not @known-bug\""
scripts.test:ui: start-server-and-test "npm --prefix sample-app start" http://127.0.0.1:4000 "npm run test:cucumber -- --tags \"@ui and not @known-bug\""
scripts.test:smoke: start-server-and-test "npm --prefix sample-app start" http://127.0.0.1:4000 "npm run test:cucumber -- --tags \"@smoke and not @known-bug\""
scripts.test:known-bugs: start-server-and-test "npm --prefix sample-app start" http://127.0.0.1:4000 "npm run test:cucumber -- --tags \"@known-bug\""
scripts.test:headed: start-server-and-test "npm --prefix sample-app start" http://127.0.0.1:4000 "npm run test:cucumber -- --world-parameters {\"headed\":true} --tags \"not @known-bug and @ui\""
